segments.comment: Independent wizard-mode death to a ghoul on a new level 3, answering yes to Save bones. end.c done_in_by() sets u.ugrave_arise to the ghoul, and bones.c savebones() makes the ghoul the hero becomes on the hero's square (makemon() with NO_MINVENT), gives it the hero's resistances (mondata.c give_u_to_m_resistances()), drops the hero's possessions into its inventory (drop_upon_death()), and has it wear them (worn.c m_dowear()). The seed, clock, character, and input were chosen for this path.
